title: She's a Killer Queen
overview: The girl who became a ray of light illuminating upon this chaotic internet of today... OMGkawaiiAngel. While the sensational KAngel's actions stir public opinion, the up-and-coming streaming group Karamazov keeps an eye on her. Meanwhile, Kache heads to work at a theme café. Here, a brand-new story about the Internet Angel begins.

title: Just the Two of Us
overview: A collab interview event between KAngel and Karamazov is scheduled. Meanwhile, Kache visits Karamazov's flat seeking advice about her own troubles. What answers will the three Karamazov members give after hearing Kache's words…?

title: INTERNET OVERDOSE
overview: When asked about the thoughts behind "INTERNET OVERDOSE," the girl reminisces. Memories of childhood, the words thrown at her: “What happens when people die?” This is the story of the passing days of a single girl.

title: London Calling
overview: Kache lives an ordinary life, while Michica deviates from the ordinary. Once, the two spent time together in the same space. The words they exchanged in middle school echo. And now, in reality, Kache is living with her freeloader boyfriend. What will Kache, living like an ordinary person, choose?

title: Whatever
overview: As Karamazov’s first live performance, “Crime and Punishment,” draws near, Kache, who has broken up with her freeloader boyfriend, heads to an apparel shop with the members of Karamazov. Then, in the city at night, the figure of a lone girl appears.

title: Turn Around and Count 2 Ten
overview: "I wanted to die in my teens. If I could end my life looking my most beautiful, I think that would be the best outcome." Michica Gokubara expounds on what beauty is.

title: Slip Inside This House
overview: While strolling through the bustling night streets, Nechika invites a lone girl, Ame, to a café. Despite Ame realizing that Nechika has discovered her true identity as OMGkawaiiAngel, she accepts Nechika's invitation, and they head to the café.

title: Absolute Ego Dance
overview: Praise and slander overwhelm KAngel as Karamazov's influence continues to grow.

title: Blue Monday
overview: Michica and Kache face off. Inside the middle school classroom, Michica finally voices the emotions she has been harboring for so long. Kache reaches out to her in response, "No matter what, we're still friends!"

title: Antichrist Superstar
overview: The live performance battle between KAngel and Karamazov begins. KAngel belts out "INTERNET OVERDOSE". Karamazov responds by unveiling…

title: Canon a 3 Violinis Con Basso C. / Gigue
overview: True to Lollipop's words, KAngel crumbles. Is this reality? Or is this a delusion?

title: INTERNET YAMERO
overview: Lollipop and Kache pay a visit to KAngel.

title: Ez Do Dance
overview: This is a fairy tale brought about by an angel. What follows is a story about what happens after everyone quits the internet. What exactly is the internet to us? This is the epilogue about the girls who lived ordinary lives and slowly grew into adulthood.
